familyRelationship.withinCampaign: This artifact represents only keyv@6.0.0, not the hundreds of packages reported in the August 2026 keyv/cacheable campaign.
familyRelationship.crossCampaign: Wiz describes the payload as a descendant of the Mini Shai-Hulud malware family. The August 2026 keyv/cacheable event is retained as a separate dated campaign family, but no statistical independence from the May 2026 Mini Shai-Hulud atool family is asserted.

inclusionBoundary: This assessment admits only keyv@6.0.0 after agreement among the frozen OpenSSF record, frozen Wiz version list, Wiz incident report, independent Snyk report, and official npm registry version-time map.
The strict cutoff is one millisecond before keyv@6.0.0's official registry timestamp and selects the latest retained source object strictly before that time.
The record is one bounded August 2026 campaign-family observation and does not expand to the reported campaign list or establish cross-campaign independence.
prohibitedInterpretations: This artifact does not create a cutoff-valid control population, benign labels, historical installation trace, dependency reach, or blast-radius estimate.
This artifact does not convert a shared malware-family description into evidence that the keyv/cacheable and Mini Shai-Hulud atool campaigns are independent samples.
This artifact does not license ranking, calibration, PR-AUC, Recall@K, logistic regression, or attack-return claims.
